note: A cap on stored energy would be a terminal_soc_kwh constraint, but the model already has a terminal_soc_kwh parameter that sets the minimum stored energy at the end of the day. The question is vague about whether it means a hard cap (max) or a minimum (terminal_soc_kwh). The model uses terminal_soc_kwh as a minimum, so setting it to 13.5 would mean the battery must end the day at 13.5 kWh (full).
